subtitle: Computer-Based Testing simulation for Pearson Test of English Reading: Fill in the Blanks & Collocations.
instructions: PTE Academic CBT Timing: 40 seconds per question item.
Reading & Writing Fill in the Blanks: Select the word that best matches academic grammar and academic collocation conventions.

questions.prompt: In academic sociology, using contemporary 21st-century technological norms to judge pre-industrial agricultural communities is regarded as methodologically ________ and intellectually misleading.
questions.explanation: 'Anachronistic' means belonging to a period other than that in which it exists; applying modern standards to pre-industrial societies misplaces chronological context.

questions.prompt: Environmental scientists reported that microplastic fragments have become ________ contaminants in oceanic food chains, found in plankton, deep-sea organisms, and apex predators alike.
questions.explanation: 'Ubiquitous' is the standard academic adjective collocated with widespread contamination occurring everywhere across an ecosystem.

questions.type: Reading & Writing: Fill in the Blanks
questions.prompt: Rather than waiting for long-term theoretical consensus on climate policy, municipal planners opted for ________ urban flood defenses that offered immediate, cost-effective storm protection.
questions.explanation: 'Pragmatic' denotes an approach guided by practical consequences and immediate feasibility rather than abstract theoretical debates.

questions.prompt: The primary advantage of the new biomedical protocol was its ________ explanation of molecular gene splicing, minimizing misunderstandings between international lab researchers.
questions.explanation: 'Lucid' means clear, rational, and easily understood, which prevents miscommunication among global teams.

questions.prompt: The temporary economic boom sparked by seasonal tourism was largely ________, leaving local infrastructure under-resourced once winter travel ceased.
questions.explanation: 'Ephemeral' describes short-lived or transitory events, precisely matching a seasonal economic surge that dissipates in winter.
